english: Let $S$ be the set of all ordered pairs $(a,b)$ of integers for which the function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ defined by $f(x)=ax+b\sin x$ is one-one and satisfies $|f(x)-f(y)|\le6|x-y|$ for all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}$. Then the number of elements in $S$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ पूर्णांकों के उन सभी क्रमित युग्मों $(a,b)$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए $f(x)=ax+b\sin x$ द्वारा परिभाषित फलन $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ एकैकी है तथा सभी $x,y\in\mathbb{R}$ के लिए $|f(x)-f(y)|\le6|x-y|$ को सन्तुष्ट करता है। तब $S$ में अवयवों की संख्या ______ है।
solution: $f'(x)=a+b\cos x$ takes all values between $a-|b|$ and $a+|b|$.
Bound: by LMVT $f(x)-f(y)=f'(\xi)(x-y)$, so the bound holds iff $|f'|\le6$ everywhere (necessity: divide by $x-y$ and let $y\to x$) $\Leftrightarrow |a|+|b|\le6$.

One-one: if $|b|>|a|$, $f'$ changes sign, $f$ is not monotonic, so not one-one; if $a=b=0$, constant. If $|a|\ge|b|$, $a\neq0$: $f'$ has constant sign with isolated zeros, strictly monotonic, one-one.
Count $|a|=k$, $|b|\le\min(k,6-k)$: $k=1,\ldots,6$ give $3,5,7,5,3,1$ values of $b$; total $24$, times $2$ signs of $a$
solution_full: $f'(x)=a+b\cos x$. As $\cos x$ runs over $[-1,1]$, $f'$ takes every value in $[a-|b|,a+|b|]$, so $\max|f'|=|a|+|b|$.

Lipschitz condition. If $|f'(t)|\le6$ for all $t$, then by Lagrange's mean value theorem $|f(x)-f(y)|=|f'(\xi)||x-y|\le6|x-y|$. Conversely, if $|f(x)-f(y)|\le6|x-y|$ for all $x,y$, then $\left|\dfrac{f(x)-f(y)}{x-y}\right|\le6$, and letting $y\to x$ gives $|f'(x)|\le6$. So the condition is $|a|+|b|\le6$.

One-one condition. A continuous one-one function on $\mathbb{R}$ is strictly monotonic. If $|b|>|a|$, then $a-|b|<0<a+|b|$, so $f'$ takes both signs on intervals and $f$ is not monotonic, hence many-one. If $a=b=0$, $f$ is constant.

Each $k$ has two values of $a$ ($\pm k$), so $|S|=2\times24=48$.
originality_note: New: integer pairs (a,b) for which ax + b sin x is simultaneously one-one and 6-Lipschitz, the Lipschitz part being exactly the LMVT bound |f'| <= 6 (way 5). Closest known: ax + b sin x is one-one iff |a| >= |b|. Different because: the extra global inequality |f(x)-f(y)| <= 6|x-y| must be converted by LMVT (both directions) into |a| + |b| <= 6, turning the problem into a lattice count.
blueprint_concepts: One-one vs many-one: monotonicity, horizontal line and algebraic tests

concept_use.LMVT and its application: f(x) - f(y) = f'(xi)(x - y) turns the condition |f(x)-f(y)| <= 6|x-y| into |a| + |b| <= 6, and shows strict monotonicity.
concept_use.One-one vs many-one: monotonicity, horiz: f one-one iff strictly monotonic iff |a| >= |b| with a not 0; a sign change of f' makes f many-one.

key_step: Translate the Lipschitz inequality via LMVT into |a|+|b| <= 6 and the one-one condition into |b| <= |a|, then count lattice points.
